Headings "Canon 6." and "Canon 7." are centred theses, and "Explicatio." is a centred italic title above a passage. A catchword sits at lower right. The left edge shows the neighbouring page (not notes). Faint show-through on the right is not transcribed.

main_text.p: fe. [?] In quem finem missus A. C.1644 Navarchus Brouverus, qui fœdus cum illis contra Hispanos iniret. Sed spes tùm temporis irrita facta fuit.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Nulla Reipublicæ species apud Brasilianos reperitur, sed domesticum tantùm imperium agnoscunt. Qui seniores natu, & plures interfecerunt hostes, quandam veluti Ducum autoritatem apud eos obtinent. Ipsorum igitur, ut & aliorum Barbarorum historia, nihil memoratu dignum habet: mera enim inter se latrocinia gerunt.

page.notes: The line "fe." at the top of the text is unclear and may be a fragment or decorative mark; marked [?]. "C.1644" is printed as shown. The left margin shows the edge of the neighbouring page and the right side shows show-through, so neither is transcribed. The catchword "Ex-" is at lower right, below the last line. Possible misreading of "tùm" (tilde uncertain).
